summary: Precision BioSciences filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a marketed follow-on offering of 10,235,077 common shares plus pre-funded warrants for 5,893,964 shares at $7.75 per share (warrant price $7.749995), grossing roughly $125.0 million and netting about $117.5 million before expenses. The $7.75 price marks a discount to the November 4, 2026 last sale of $8.12. TD Cowen and Guggenheim Securities are underwriters; closing is expected on or about November 6, 2026. This is a routine equity capital raise rather than a special situation; watch dilution and post-deal overhang.
